title: Elodie and the Static
author: Wendell Lockridge
blurb: Silas Ishikawa, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
